item.title: Woman Charged After Dogs and Cats Found Abandoned, Malnourished in Girardville Home
item.description: A Duncannon woman is facing multiple animal cruelty and neglect charges after Pennsylvania State Police say she abandoned a dog and four cats inside a Girardville residence without proper care, resulting in severe neglect and the death of one cat. According to court documents, Alicia Ann Rovin, 34, of Duncannon, was charged on January 29th, 2026, by State Police with cruelty to animals, multiple counts of neglect of animals, and abandoning a dog within the Commonwealth. item.title: Spartans’ Cadyn McGraw Reaches 100-Win Milestone
item.description: North Schuylkill senior wrestler Cadyn McGraw added his name to the program’s history books Saturday, becoming the newest member of the Spartans’ 100 Win Club during the District XI Class AA Dual Tournament. McGraw reached the milestone with a victory over Saucon Valley in the tournament semifinals. item.description: PennDOT has announced multiple pothole patching projects scheduled to take place across Schuylkill County beginning Monday, February 2, 2026. item.title: Orwigsburg House Destroyed in Fire; Family Assisted by Red Cross
item.description: A fire destroyed a home in Orwigsburg on Saturday.Just before noon on Saturday, emergency personnel were dispatched to a reported working house fire at 501 Lee Street in Orwigsburg. Police and fire crews arrived to find heavy fire conditions coming from the side and rear of the residence. Firefighters immediately began battling the blaze, working for more than an hour before the fire was brought under control. The home sustained extensive damage and was destroyed by the fire.
